title: Graviclaw
definition: The Graviclaw is a black-shelled crustacean Xalian of Grimedes, generated with an upright torso above a crab-like body and an intensifying command of gravitational waves. It hunts from beneath the foggy wetlands by opening miniature black holes in the water to drag prey into its massive claws, and can root itself immovably to the ground when it meets a larger opponent.
